name: Estel
source:
"There is only one man who allows to touch you...that is me"

Race: Elf
Weapon: Bow, Knife

Estel is one of three men traveling with us to get the sword back.
Known for his gracious fighting style and stunning look. This man who treasures nature like his life.
When we first introduced he looks familiar to me, like we even met before.
Why does he keep staring at me?
Was it a sign of...or just a misunderstanding?
